projects.name: RAG Knowledge Assistant (PFE-RAG)
projects.description: Final-year project: full-stack Retrieval-Augmented Generation application that ingests PDF, image and Office documents (OCR, table extraction, contextual chunking), indexes them with FAISS embeddings plus BM25, and answers questions with source citations through local LLMs served by Ollama. Includes JWT authentication, conversation history, admin/audit features, RAGAS evaluation, Phoenix tracing and LLM/quantization benchmarks.

projects.name: E-Learning Adaptatif AI
projects.description: Adaptive e-learning platform that detects learner frustration in real time from the front camera with an on-device TensorFlow Lite model (MobileNetV2) and streams the score to a live teacher dashboard. Spring Boot REST API (JWT auth, courses, lessons, quizzes, learning sessions) with a Flutter mobile app.

projects.name: Navigation Assistance App for Visually Impaired Users (ProjetAiMalvoyant_V2)
projects.description: Android app for visually impaired users: real-time obstacle detection on the camera feed with a TensorFlow Lite SSD MobileNet v1 model, monocular distance estimation, spoken obstacle announcements (French or Darija) and GPS guidance on an OpenStreetMap map with OSRM routing. Built on top of a public real-time object detection tutorial.

projects.name: MobileSec-MS
projects.description: Academic microservice platform (7 FastAPI services) for automated static security analysis of Android APKs: manifest and permission checks, hard-coded secret detection, weak cryptography and network-security configuration analysis, an aggregated risk report and OWASP MASVS-aligned fix suggestions, plus a CI connector and a GitHub Actions workflow.

projects.name: QuizApp (Dockerized)
projects.description: Team project (5 contributors): full-stack quiz platform where admins create and manage quizzes and users take them with instant feedback and an analytics dashboard. JWT role-based security, Swagger-documented REST API, frontend and backend containerized with Docker Compose.

projects.name: GestionTacheProjet (AI-assisted project & task management)
projects.description: Project and task management platform with JWT role-based access, CRUD for projects, tasks, collaborators and assignments, and an integrated local AI assistant (Ollama, Llama 3.2 3B) that analyses urgent tasks, collaborator performance and projects, predicts project completion and answers free-form questions. Layered ASP.NET Core API with a React dashboard.

projects.name: HotelReservation (Desktop + Web)
projects.description: Hotel management system in two parts sharing one SQL Server database: a Windows Forms desktop app for reception staff (rooms, clients, reservations, payments, analytics dashboard, PDF/Excel exports, e-mail notifications) and an ASP.NET Core MVC web portal where clients browse rooms, register and book.

projects.name: MarketPlace Java
projects.description: JavaFX desktop marketplace with sign-up/login, a product catalog, product listing management and user-to-user chat, plus an optional webcam login that compares the captured image with the profile photo using OpenCV (grayscale pixel difference).
